// CASE ts_dup_quotes_before_40 expect=fire
export async function run<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge('k0', 'k1', 'k2', 'k3', 'k4', 'k5', 'k6', 'k7', 'k8', 'k9', 'k10', 'k11', 'k12', 'k13', 'k14', 'k15', 'k16', 'k17', 'k18', 'k19', 'k20', 'k21', 'k22', 'k23', 'k24', 'k25', 'k26', 'k27', 'k28', 'k29', 'k30', 'k31', 'k32', 'k33', 'k34', 'k35', 'k36', 'k37', 'k38', 'k39', await operation(items[index]), await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
